Why we are giving away the first year

Chess Nexus is new. A coach choosing where to run their teaching is trusting us with their students, their schedule and their income, and asking them to pay for that on day one — before anyone they know has heard of us — is asking a lot.

So the first 50 coaches do not pay. They get the full Pro plan for twelve months, and in return we get what a new platform actually needs: real coaches running real classes, telling us what is missing. Founding coaches also appear in our public coach directory, where parents looking for a coach can find them.

What the founding year includes

Everything in the Pro plan, unchanged and unmetered for twelve months.

Up to 70 students

Your roster holds 70 active students at once for the whole year — more than double the 30 the free plan allows. Organise them into as many batches as you like, by level, age or class time.

Unlimited live classes

Run as many live classes a day as you want, with no daily cap. The free plan allows one class a day; founding coaches have no limit for a year.

Unlimited students in the room

No cap on how many students join a single live class. The free plan admits 4 students plus the coach; a founding coach can teach a whole batch at once.

Classes up to 120 minutes

Three times the 40-minute limit on the free plan, long enough for a full lesson plus game review.

The complete live classroom

HD video, screen share, a shared board every student sees, board control handed to any student, drawing and arrows, a waiting room, raise hand, and one-click homework. No Zoom link, no separate account — it runs inside Chess Nexus.

Unlimited courses and lessons

Free coaches get 30 courses with 3 lessons each. On Pro there is no cap on either — build a full syllabus from your own studies, Nexus studies, videos, master games and endgame positions.

All 7 assignment types

Puzzle topics, a whole study, a single chapter, timed Puzzle Rush, arena tournaments, play-vs-Stockfish positions from a visual board editor, and custom tasks. Solve rate and accuracy are recorded per student automatically.

Premium endgames and the repertoire trainer

Premium endgame positions and the opening repertoire trainer, free for you and free for your students inside your courses and assignments.

Unlimited Team Race and Monthly Focus

Run team races for your batches and set a monthly focus topic as often as you like, with no monthly quota.

Everything on the free plan

Attendance, class schedule with automatic timezone conversion, fee and payment tracking, parent progress reports, coach-student chat, private class activities and your public coach page — all included, all unchanged.

How to claim it

1. Open the Coach page

The Coach page shows how many founding spots are left, live. If the counter is still open, the offer is still available.

2. Tell us about your coaching

A short onboarding: who you coach, where, and how you teach. It takes a few minutes and needs no payment details.

3. We verify you

Every coach is checked by the Chess Nexus team, usually within 12 hours, before they can add students. This keeps the platform safe for children.

4. Your Pro year starts

Once you are verified and inside the first 50, the Pro plan is applied to your account. Nothing to pay, nothing to cancel.

Questions coaches ask

What exactly is the founding coach offer?

The first 50 coaches to join Chess Nexus get the Pro plan free for one full year. Pro normally costs $19 a month (₹1299 in India), so the year is worth $228 — about ₹15,588. There is nothing to pay and no card required.

Is a card required?

No. You do not enter card or payment details to claim the founding year. If you decide not to continue after the year, nothing is charged and nothing renews without you choosing it.

What happens after the free year ends?

Nothing is charged automatically. Your account moves to the free plan, which is free forever for up to 30 students and keeps your courses, students, attendance history and parent reports. You can upgrade to Pro at $19 a month whenever you want, or carry on free.

How do I know if spots are still available?

The live count of remaining spots is shown on the Coach page. When the offer is claimed in full, the counter closes and the page stops advertising it — you will never see a spot that is not really there.

Do I have to be a titled or full-time coach?

No. Club coaches, academy coaches and independent coaches all qualify. Every coach is verified by the Chess Nexus team before they can add students, usually within 12 hours — that check keeps the platform safe for children, and is not a judgement of your rating.

Can I move students from another platform?

Yes. You can invite students by link or username, and they keep their own Chess Nexus account for puzzles, endgames and games. There is no import fee and no limit on how many you bring across, up to the 70 the Pro plan allows.

Is this a trial?

No. A trial is a countdown that ends with a card prompt. This is the paid Pro plan, granted free for twelve months. When it ends you fall back to the free plan rather than losing access.

What does it cost after the founding year?

Pro is $19 a month (₹1299 in India) for up to 70 students, and Coach is $33 a month (₹2444) for up to 150. Both include the unlimited live classroom. The free plan stays free forever for up to 30 students.

Claim a founding spot

There are 50 in total and they are granted in order. The Coach page shows how many are left right now — when they are gone, the offer closes.

Not ready yet? The free plan is free forever for up to 30 students, with no card and no trial clock.
